entities.summary: Budapest's Inner City Parish Church, officially the Church of the Blessed Virgin Mary, is the main parish church of Budapest. It is often referred to as the City Parish Church, or Downtown Parish Church. It is located adjacent to the walls of the Roman Contra-Aquincum Fortress and the Elisabeth Bridge.
